repo_meta_data.description: Git-native context layer for AI coding agents. Your team's real engineering decisions — patterns, pitfalls, conventions — live as reviewed markdown files in your repo; agents consult them before writing code and record what they learn. Files-first, no server required; MCP as an optional serving layer.
